NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR PROPOSED REZONING FOR A ZONING
AMENDMENT — (3622 W. DOUGLAS BLVD.)

The current zoning of the parcel is RT-4 District. The zoning amendment is
required to change the zoning of the parcel to C1-2 District. The zoning change is
needed to permit a Commercial Kitchen to operate at this location. The proposed use of
the property will be to serve meals to the public, conduct culinary classes, catering

operations and religious services. There are no onsite parking spaces. The height is
67'4".

Lot Area: 10,950.39 sq. ft.
FAR: 41.2

Building Area: 27,221.5 sq. ft.
Density/Dwelling Unit: QO sq. ft.

Off Street Parking Spaces: 0 spaces
Front Setback: (Existing) 9’ - 0”

Rear Setback: (Existing) o’-1"
Sideyard (East): 6’-4”
Sideyard (West): 0’- 8”

Rear Yard Open Space: 0

Building Height: s7'- 4"

After rezoning, the property shall be used to operate a commercial kitchen to serve
meals to the public, conduct culinary classes. catering operations and religious services.
There are no onsite parking spaces. The height is 67’4”.
